facts.text: UWF's Argo 30 Guarantee covers all tuition and mandatory fees not met by other aid for up to 30 credit hours annually for full-time Pell-eligible Florida undergraduates.

sources.title: Argo 30 Guarantee | University of West Florida
sources.quote: UWF's Argo 30 Guarantee is the University's pledge to cover tuition and mandatory fees for low-income students.

sources.title: Argo 30 Guarantee | University of West Florida
sources.quote: Argo 30 will cover all tuition and mandatory fees not covered by other grants or scholarships (up to 30 credit hours each academic year, fall and spring semesters, for a maximum of four years).
